risks.risk: Console model may not be what the seller claims (e.g., Series X vs One X vs Series S), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (or the console front/back model text) and the Settings > System > Console info screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value Xbox model consistent with the photos (worst case: not the claimed model).

risks.risk: Installed games list/count may be different from the seller’s claim (some tiles may be shortcuts, demos, or not actually installed).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the Xbox 'My games & apps' library showing the installed games list and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/unknown installed games (worst case: only the clearly shown EA FC title is confirmed).

risks.risk: Games shown may not match the seller’s text (seller says FC 26 but photo shows EA FC 25).
risks.proof: A photo of the exact game title in the dashboard/library (highlight the game and show the title clearly).
risks.if_unproven: Price with the mismatch treated as incorrect (worst case: seller’s game list is unreliable).

risks.risk: Console may have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, controller drift, HDMI/port problems) that photos cannot reveal.
risks.proof: Video clip of the console booting, loading a game from the dashboard, and quick controller input test (moving sticks/buttons) with no lag/errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Accessories/contents may be incomplete (power cable, HDMI cable, controller condition, original box).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out: power brick/cable, HDMI cable, controller(s), headset (if any), and any manuals/box.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items (worst case: only console + one controller + basic cables).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (front/back) or Settings > System > Console info showing the exact model.
Photo/screenshot of 'My games & apps' showing the installed games list (and that there are 6 installed).
Photo of the highlighted game title(s) to confirm the exact names (especially FC 26 vs EA FC 25).
Short video: boot to dashboard, launch one game, and show controller inputs working (no drift/lag).
Photo of all included accessories laid out (power/HDMI/controller and any extras).
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox console is present and EA FC is running, but the console model and the exact installed games list/count are not readable/confirmable. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
